decisions.reason: A multi-model garage door operator line is a core complement to the residential garage door range, so it is likely to be updated rather than withdrawn, even though it was not observed on the website in 2020 to 2021.
Glazed industrial sectional doors remain a standard part of the industrial portfolio, but with three similar glazed variants D carries some risk of being consolidated into the others.
Demand for energy-efficient insulated doors in commercial buildings is still rising and matches the firm's thermal solutions focus.
F was featured on its own page, so it is likely the lead glazed industrial door the firm would keep if it consolidated the variants.
